subject: Log unexpected $ENDOFF responses in dual channel replication (#839)
reason: The diff adds only a serverLog(LL_WARNING, ...) call on an already-existing error path in fullSyncWithPrimary (dual-channel replication): when sscanf fails to parse the $ENDOFF response, the code goes to the same goto error as before, now with a log line first. There is no change to replies, replication state, data handling, or control flow, and the new log fires only if a primary sends a malformed $ENDOFF, which no genuine Valkey build produces.
